payload.title: Working with `Pandas`
payload.description: This notebook explores the integration of Pandas with Pyleoclim for paleoclimate data analysis. It demonstrates how to export Pyleoclim Series to Pandas Series, perform unit conversions, select data based on time or value criteria, and handle CSV import/export. The notebook also covers resampling techniques and operations with MultipleSeries objects, showcasing the enhanced capabilities for data processing and visualization.
